summary: Bounded repair of the declared missing factor-level mappings: the F-isolation level 'no room shared between tests' is added as a factorLevels link to all four existing scenarios (S-maxplayers-2-201, S-maxplayers-8-201, S-maxplayers-1-400, S-maxplayers-9-400). It is a fixed fixture precondition, not an extra test, and is backed exactly by REQ-007's quote 'Each test uses a fresh framework fixture and creates no shared room', which every updated scenario already lists in requirementIds, so the factor-requirement overlap holds. F-isolation already declares both of its levels, so no factor record is changed and the factors patch is empty. All existing IDs, titles, dimensions, expected outcomes, requirement links, fixed inputs, and the four-scenario scope are preserved verbatim; no factors, scenarios, levels, or assertions are added or removed, nothing is deleted or excluded, and no execution is claimed.
